new_results.statement: Under clique-factor off-diagonal geometry, |Aii|<tau, and all physical principal 2x2 determinant magnitudes <tau, s3(A)<tau+sqrt(tau+tau^2). Hence no such target with s3(A)>=1 exists for tau<1/3.

At tau=1/128, combining the exact star/triangle/clique classification with the new clique estimate rules out every exact all-cut-rank-one strict-N3 target matrix. Therefore some disjoint physical cross cut has rank at least two, without any quantitative second-singular-value claim.
